body: I haven't seen this new slider live, but `transform: translate()` usually works better when positioning stuff.

body: The [`translatable`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/instantsearch-react/packages/instantsearch-react/src/translatable.js) HOC consumes a `translations` prop that is a map of translation key to translation strings/functions, and forwards a `translate` prop that is a function.
